question: Which of the following is the lightest gas ?
solution:
The correct answer is __Hydrogen.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• Hydrogen is the lightest gas in the world.
 
• Hydrogen is a chemical element.
 
• It is the first element in the periodic table which is also the lightest.
 
• It is found most abundantly in the universe.
 
• Most of the mass of the stars and the Sun is made up of hydrogen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**Nitrogen: 

 
• Nitrogen is a colorless, odorless, and tasteless gas.
 
• Its atomic number is 7.
 
• Nitrogen gas was discovered by Rutherford in 1773.
 
• Nitrogen is the seventh element of the periodic table.

Carbon Dioxide :

 
• It is a colorless gas with a density of about 53% higher than that of dry air.
 
• Its molecules consist of a carbon atom covalently double bonded to two oxygen atoms.
